summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income any damages awarded in lawsuits under the Camp Lejeune Justice Act of 2022, effective for amounts received after enactment.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude certain damages received under the Camp Lejeune Justice Act of 2022 from gross income. This directly reduces the tax burden on individuals receiving these specific damages, thus lowering taxes for those affected.

The bill's sole purpose is to exclude Camp Lejeune Justice Act damages from gross income under the tax code, directly forgoing federal revenue on those amounts. This revenue reduction increases the deficit, making the legislation a clear (if narrow) push in the -1 direction.
